title: A quieter, hands-on first lesson, friends on the main menu, and a server closer to most players
notes: The first lesson is guided one action at a time
The master no longer speaks: his words are on the card, and the lesson's 78 voice clips are gone (the app is 0.8 MB smaller)
In the lesson your own pagodas hold their fire and you cannot die, so nothing interrupts a step
The menu tour is 6 stops instead of 22: Play, Heroes, Shop, Profile, Quests and Settings
Friends and party on the main menu
The game server moved from Oregon to Ohio, closer to most of our players. Accounts, ranks and friends moved with it
